# HD Smoke Shop

> HD Smoke Shop is a 21+ smoke shop in Altamonte Springs, Florida. The official website is puff2door.com and supports in-store shopping and local delivery within the published delivery area.

Use the pages below for current store information, product availability, delivery rules, age and ID requirements, and customer policies. Product availability and prices can change; use the live product and catalog pages as the source of truth. No product is intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease.

## Store and shopping

- [Homepage](https://puff2door.com/): Store overview, featured products, hours, and local shopping information.
- [Shop](https://puff2door.com/shop): Current catalog, prices, and product availability.
- [Brands](https://puff2door.com/brands): Brands currently represented in the catalog.
- [Delivery area](https://puff2door.com/delivery-area): ZIP eligibility, delivery process, and local delivery information.
- [Contact](https://puff2door.com/contact): Store contact information, address, hours, and directions.
- [Track an order](https://puff2door.com/track): Customer order tracking.

## Policies and help

- [Frequently asked questions](https://puff2door.com/faq): Answers about shopping, delivery, identification, and payments.
- [Age and ID policy](https://puff2door.com/age-and-id-policy): 21+ requirements and accepted identification.
- [Delivery policy](https://puff2door.com/delivery-policy): Delivery terms and customer responsibilities.
- [Refund and return policy](https://puff2door.com/refund-policy): Refund and return conditions.
- [Privacy policy](https://puff2door.com/privacy-policy): How customer information is handled.
- [Terms and conditions](https://puff2door.com/terms): Website and purchase terms.

## Optional
